items.title: Trump Tells GM Workers “I’ve Done More For You Than Your Parents.” Michigan Lost 4,000 Auto Parts Jobs This Year.

items.title: Tesla Continues Its 2026 Crash. This Prominent Analyst Believes It’ll Rise 85% in 12 Months.
items.summary: Tesla has shed 15% in 2026 while the broader market climbs, yet one of Wall Street's most vocal analysts just doubled down on a target that implies the stock is nowhere near finished.
